title: How the Adaptive Digital SAT Actually Works
description:
The digital SAT adapts to how you do, and there are a lot of rumors about how. This video sticks to College Board's own explanations: how modules and routing work, how scoring works (and what College Board doesn't publish), what it means for your strategy, and a quick myth-or-fact check.

You'll learn:
• Why the SAT adapts by module, not question by question
• What module 1 and module 2 contain
• Why both modules count, and why a harder module 2 isn't a reason to panic
• Pretest questions, guessing, and moving around inside a module
• A simple test-day plan: careful module 1, calm module 2, no blanks

This video has no practice questions; any examples shown are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. Sources: College Board's "How the SAT Is Structured", "How Are Scores Calculated?", the Digital SAT test specifications, and College Board's "What Is Digital SAT Adaptive Testing?"
